items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Johnny Tobin he was a banjo player society family and he had Jack Asunto was playing trombone with him and he had Warren Herron playing drums and I don't know I remember the guys

ctx.x: What were some of the places that music was played over in Biloxi?

Well they always had they had a good band a named band at the White House Johnny Tobin Johnny Tobin's band he was in the wintertime he played at the Pete Herman's down on Bourbon Street it was a nightclub not a two bits club it was a good nightclub in those days and it was a good band too.
